scope: Offline chart lint and Helm 4 readiness only; not application runtime or full upgrade validation

findings.title: Chart still on API v2
findings.detail: Helm 4 continues to support v2, but new capabilities (sequencing, alternate render engines, signer plugins) land on the v3 roadmap.
findings.recommendation: Create v3 migration backlog; do not force-convert immediately.

findings.title: Heavy Go template composition detected
findings.detail: Alternate render engines (CUE, YAMLScript) are a Charts v3 motivation. Heavy template coupling makes future engine migration harder.
findings.recommendation: Separate data shaping from rendering logic.

findings.title: .helmignore may have limited semantics
findings.detail: .helmignore ↔ .gitignore parity is a long-standing request addressed in Charts v3.
findings.recommendation: Include ignore semantics review in migration plan.

findings.title: Values may need parent/subchart transform
findings.detail: Parent/subchart values transform is a Charts v3 plugin candidate.
findings.evidence: values.yaml contains a top-level 'deployment' block with subchart-style override keys
findings.recommendation: Add to values-transform plugin readiness backlog.
